updates.t: ANSI/ISEA Z89.1-2026 head protection standard released
updates.b: The new edition keeps helmet Types I and II and Classes G, E and C, and adds optional Type I+ and II+ ratings for chin-strap retention (Type I+ also multi-directional impact). The HV marking becomes EV. Current compliant helmets are not made obsolete.

updates.t: ANSI/ISEA Z87.1-2025 eye and face protection published
updates.b: The revision clarifies product markings, updates impact, lens and coverage requirements, and aligns with ANSI/ISEA Z97.62 for blood and body fluids.

updates.t: SAIS launches national industrial security platform
updates.b: The Supreme Authority for Industrial Security (formerly HCIS) launched an industrial security platform and operations centre. SAF safety and fire directives continue to apply to supervised facilities.

updates.t: Saudi midday outdoor work ban in force
updates.b: Outdoor work under direct sun banned 12:00–15:00 from 15 June to 15 September 2026. MHRSD reported 94% compliance in 2025.
The new edition of the environmental management system standard replaces ISO 14001:2015. A transition period of about 3 years is expected for certified organizations.

updates.t: OSHA renews its Heat National Emphasis Program
updates.b: CPL 03-00-024 replaces the 2022 heat NEP. The proposed federal heat rule is still not final; a supplemental proposal is planned for December 2026.
After a 180-day transition from January 2025, the 2024 SBC edition, including SBC 801 Saudi Fire Code, applies to all new and existing projects.

updates.t: Saudi Labor Law amendments take effect
updates.b: Royal Decree M/44 amendments are in force. The core OSH articles 121–124 and 127–130 were not changed.

updates.t: OSHA HazCom updated to GHS Rev. 7
updates.b: The revised Hazard Communication Standard changes labels and SDS rules, with compliance dates phased from 2026.
Emergency management, business continuity, mass evacuation and pre-incident planning are now in one standard.
